note: All figures rigorously sourced. Confidence: HIGH = Ajuntament/BIMSA primary source; MEDIUM = peer-reviewed European study; LOW = single secondary source or international extrapolation. See outputs/intervention-costs-research.md for full methodology, source quotes, and limitations.

de-paving.description: Asphalt/concrete removal, base reconstruction, structural soil installation, tree pit reconstruction, permeable surface reinstatement. The dominant cost driver in Barcelona's Eixos Verds programme.

cost_per_m2_eur.derivation: Derived from the BIMSA contract for the four Eixample green axes UP1-UP4 (Consell de Cent, Girona, Rocafort, Comte Borrell + four squares): EUR 42.07M ex-VAT / EUR 50.90M inc-VAT for ~86,000 m2 of transformed surface = EUR 489-592/m2 ex-VAT, EUR 592-716/m2 inc-VAT. The range widens to 450-800/m2 to capture variance between full-rebuild axes (higher) and lighter de-paving (lower).
cost_per_m2_eur.notes: Composite figure: includes de-paving, structural soil, drainage, paving with permeable surface, urban furniture, lighting, and 500 new tree pits. Not a pure-asphalt-removal figure. For pure asphalt removal alone, peer-reviewed Eu studies suggest EUR 30-80/m2 plus disposal; full Barcelona-grade reconstruction is the more decision-relevant figure here.

typical_intervention_size_m2.note: Eixample programme: 4 axes x 4.65 km total = 11.12 ha = 111,200 m2 of axis surface; plus 4 squares of ~2,000 m2 each = 8,000 m2.

maintenance_eur_per_year_per_m2.derivation: Estimated from reported maintenance cost increases of approx EUR 1.1M/year across the four new Eixample axes (~86,000 m2) = ~EUR 12.8/m2/year. Confirmed by the EUR 9.6M/year Tree Master Plan budget against ~310,800 trees + green areas. Range covers light vs intensive maintenance regimes.
maintenance_eur_per_year_per_m2.notes: MEDIUM confidence. Numbers reflect Ajuntament reporting but exact per-m2 derivation involves the analyst combining two sources.

de-paving.lifetime_note: Structural soil systems (Stockholm method analogue) are designed for 30+ years if not damaged by utility works. Surface paving typically 15-25 years.

cooling.description: Urban-heat-island mitigation that is NOT primarily about tree canopy: misters, ornamental fountains, reflective and draining pavements, shade structures (pergolas, awnings), climate-shelter retrofits of public buildings.

cost_per_m2_eur_shade_structure.derivation: Barcelona Refugis Climatics a les Escoles (UIA/ERDF + Ajuntament): 11 schools, 2019-2022, EUR 5M total (EUR 4M ERDF + EUR 1M Ajuntament) delivered 2,213 m2 of new shade space (pergolas, awnings) plus 1,000 m2 of de-paved natural soil, 74 trees, 26 water points. Allocating ~50% of budget to shade = EUR 2.5M / 2,213 m2 = EUR 1,130/m2 if narrowly attributed, but the lower range (80-450) reflects standalone shade-structure unit costs from European NbS literature.
cost_per_m2_eur_shade_structure.notes: Range deliberately wide. The Refugi Climatic programme is a composite intervention; standalone shade-structure prices alone are at the lower end.

cost_per_climate_shelter_retrofit_eur.derivation: EUR 5M / 11 schools = EUR 455k/school for full green+blue+grey package (vegetation, shade, water points, insulation works).
cost_per_climate_shelter_retrofit_eur.notes: HIGH confidence for the central figure (Ajuntament press release, EU UIA project).

fountains_misters_per_unit_eur.derivation: 26 new water points in 11 schools at EUR 5M total + estimated allocation. Treat with caution.
fountains_misters_per_unit_eur.notes: Per-unit fountain installation cost not separately published by Ajuntament. Range from general NbS literature.

tree_canopy_per_m2_eur.derivation: Peer-reviewed cost-effectiveness analysis of European urban NbS reports a median of EUR 56/m2 for green space (Cortinovis et al. 2024, Nature Reviews Earth and Environment / Sustainable Cities and Society - cost-effectiveness analysis). Mediterranean cost variation noted; use this as a benchmark only.
tree_canopy_per_m2_eur.notes: Applies to canopy/groundcover greening as a cooling intervention, separate from de-paving.

programme_anchor.scope: Heat resilience programme: includes 160 ha new green space target by 2030, 9 ha shade target, draining/reflective pavements, fountain optimisation, climate shelters, beach protection, school AC, vulnerable-people support.

planting.description: Street and park tree planting: nursery acquisition + transport + planting + first 2-3 years establishment maintenance + watering infrastructure.

cost_per_tree_eur.derivation: Pauleit et al. 2002 (COST Action E12 European survey, 17 countries): street tree establishment costs range '<EUR 200 to >EUR 1,500 per tree'. German benchmark: EUR 1,200-5,000 (urban premium). For Mediterranean Spain with cheaper labour but premium specifications, central estimate of EUR 800 per tree is defensible.
cost_per_tree_eur.notes: Barcelona-specific per-tree planting cost is NOT publicly disaggregated by the Ajuntament (the Tree Master Plan reports lump-sum annual budgets, not unit prices). Central EUR 800 is an analyst estimate that fits within the published European range; a phone call to Parcs i Jardins would tighten this.

cost_per_tree_with_structural_soil_eur.derivation: Eixample Eixos Verds: 500 new trees within EUR 52.7M total budget = up to EUR 105,400 per tree if the entire cost is allocated to the trees (false attribution). More realistic: structural soil + tree pit + tree itself in a full-rebuild context = EUR 1,500-6,000 per tree based on Stockholm-method case studies and Pauleit upper range.

maintenance_eur_per_tree_per_year.derivation: Barcelona Trees for Life Plan: EUR 9.6M/year total, of which EUR 8.3M operational, divided by ~310,800 trees = EUR 26.7/tree/year. Adjusted upwards for street trees (more attention) to EUR 31 central. Range covers low-attention park trees vs high-attention heritage trees.

planting.lifetime_note: Designed lifetime 50-80 years for street trees in good conditions; actual median lifetime in dense urban Mediterranean cities is shorter due to heat/drought/compaction stress.

sapling_mortality_5yr_pct.derivation: Hilbert et al. 2019 (US Forest Service literature review): annual establishment mortality rates for planting cohorts of 2.8-9.3% (interquartile range) yield 5-year compounded mortality of ~13-46%. Sacramento Shade Tree Program found 54% survival at 5 years (46% mortality). Mediterranean conditions with extreme heat events likely toward the upper end of this range.
sapling_mortality_5yr_pct.notes: Critical risk variable. Barcelona-specific mortality not publicly disaggregated; the Pla Director Arbrat acknowledges climate stress is a primary risk to its 5%-canopy-increase target.

planting.confidence: HIGH for maintenance, MEDIUM for unit cost, MEDIUM for mortality

species-selection.description: The marginal cost of selecting mycorrhizally-appropriate or climate-adapted species OVER the default species mix. This is a planning/protocol cost, not a separate physical intervention.

marginal_cost_per_tree_eur.derivation: Species selection adds at most a premium for nursery-rare specimens. Native AM-hosts like Celtis australis, Tilia, Quercus ilex are nursery-stocked in Catalonia. The marginal cost is the planning effort + occasional supply chain premium for less-common stock. Most cost is internalised in the per-tree price.
marginal_cost_per_tree_eur.notes: This is a soft cost. The real value is risk-reduction: a well-matched species has lower mortality and lower establishment cost over its lifetime.

mycorrhizal_inoculation_per_tree_eur.derivation: Commercial mycorrhizal inoculum: per-seedling treatment costs reported at <USD 0.10-0.30 in forestry (Auburn Nursery Coop) and up to USD 28-32/lb for retail. For a single mature transplant treatment, realistic cost EUR 1-25 depending on formulation and dose.
mycorrhizal_inoculation_per_tree_eur.notes: Koziol et al. 2025 meta-analysis (New Phytologist) found globally-sourced commercial inoculants underperform local strains. The cheap unit cost should not lead to over-investment in poorly-validated products. Best practice is to ensure soil conditions support native AM colonisation rather than to inoculate.

soil_amendment_compost_per_tree_eur.derivation: Compost and basic soil amendment per tree pit: 0.5-2 m3 of compost at EUR 30-75/m3 plus labour. Standard horticultural practice cost.

species-selection.notes: Species-selection is largely a process intervention. The biggest cost lever is matching species to site conditions to reduce 5-year mortality from ~30% to ~10%, which dwarfs any inoculation/amendment savings.

Eixos_Verds_Eixample_first_phase.scope: UP1 Consell de Cent, UP2 Girona, UP3 Rocafort, UP4 Comte Borrell + plazas Rocafort, Comte Borrell, Enric Granados, Girona. Eixample district.

Pi_i_Margall_axis.scope: Major arterial transformation; Parc Ciutadella to Collserola connection; 80% shade target; sustainable drainage.

Superilla_Sant_Antoni_tactical_2017_2019.scope: Tactical urbanism phase: painted ground, planters, urban furniture. Outcomes: traffic -17%, pollution -40% at key junction.

Superilla_Sant_Antoni_definitive_2026_20.scope: Definitive permanent works to convert tactical superblock into permanent infrastructure. Spring 2026 start, completion Spring 2027.

Trees_for_Life_Master_Plan_2017_2037.scope: All tree management, maintenance, planting, replacement, communication, participation across 310,800 individually-managed trees.

key_targets.scope: Climate shelters in all districts, draining/reflective pavements, fountain optimisation

Pla_Clima_Barcelona_2024_2030.scope: Umbrella climate plan including Pla Calor, Pla Resiliencia, Pla Mobilitat, Pla Transicio Energetica, Pla Clima Barris, Canviem pel Clima.

EIB_Loan_2025.scope: Co-finances Barcelona PIM 2024-2027 across urban regeneration, green space, flood protection, sustainable mobility, public buildings. Supports Pla Clima and Pla Viure.

heatwave_excess_mortality_2022_spain_dea.study: Ballester et al. (2023) Nature Medicine, led by ISGlobal Barcelona

value_of_statistical_life_year_eur.scope: European median VSLY; in 2014 EUR. Apply inflation-adjustment of ~25% to bring to 2026 prices = EUR 147,000-289,000 per life-year
value_of_statistical_life_year_eur.study: Systematic review of European VSLY studies (Value in Health 2017)

barcelona_eixos_verds_premature_deaths_p.scope: Full city-wide Green Corridors plan, vs status quo
barcelona_eixos_verds_premature_deaths_p.study: Iungman et al. (2025) Environment International, DOI 10.1016/j.envint.2025.109313

european_30pct_canopy_summer_deaths_prev.study: Iungman et al. (2023) The Lancet, DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(22)02585-5

barcelona_urban_forest_air_pollution_val.scope: Total Barcelona urban forest annual air pollution removal value (2008 study year)

barcelona_urban_forest_carbon_sequestrat.scope: Annual net carbon sequestration value (2008 study year)

EU_ETS_carbon_price_eur_per_tonne_2026_m.scope: EU ETS allowance spot price on 8 May 2026 (Trading Economics). Range over 2025-26: EUR 60-85/tonne. Forecast EUR 100/t by 2027, EUR 126/t by 2030.

norma_granada_madrid_tree_replacement_va.scope: Typical replacement value of medium-large urban tree under the Spanish standard Norma Granada 2020, applied in Madrid
norma_granada_madrid_tree_replacement_va.notes: Mature non-replaceable specimens (heritage trees) carry values much higher than this range. The Norma Granada method is the legally binding standard for Madrid Region and de facto reference in Catalonia.

methodology_notes.currency_year_adjustment: All EUR figures cited are nominal at the year of publication of the source. Where appropriate the report adjusts for inflation using a simple +3% annual factor; uncertainty is absorbed into the min-max ranges. Pre-2022 figures may be ~10-15% lower in real terms than the central estimates suggest.
methodology_notes.vat_treatment: BIMSA contracts are reported both with and without VAT (Spanish IVA 21%). Operational figures and per-m2 estimates use the with-VAT figure as the planner-facing cost. Inflation-adjusted estimates use the with-VAT base.
methodology_notes.composite_vs_pure_costs: The Eixos Verds per-m2 figure (EUR 600/m2 central) is a COMPOSITE - it bundles de-paving, structural soil, new paving, drainage, lighting, urban furniture, tree pits, irrigation, and plantings. A pure-asphalt-removal figure would be lower (~EUR 30-80/m2 from European NbS literature). For a planner sizing an Eixos Verds-grade intervention, the composite figure is the correct anchor.
methodology_notes.unverifiable_figures: Per-tree planting cost in Barcelona is NOT publicly disaggregated by the Ajuntament. The EUR 800/tree central estimate is an analyst projection from European survey data (Pauleit 2002 + recent benchmarks). A phone call to Parcs i Jardins de Barcelona is the single highest-value verification step still outstanding.
